India Rejects Ex-Japanese Minister's Claims on Bullet Train Project

India has rejected claims made by a former Japanese minister regarding the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project. The minister had alleged that India violated the pact and caused delays, but India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stated these claims were "at variance with facts." The project, a significant infrastructure initiative, is proceeding with ongoing discussions between India and Japan.
